description: This file contains Windows console handling code for the Git project, including functions for console output, ANSI escape code processing, and handling of Windows-specific console features.

methods.name: warn_if_raster_font
methods.description: Checks if the console font supports Unicode and warns if it does not.

methods.name: is_console
methods.description: Determines if a given file descriptor is attached to a console.

methods.name: write_console
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 to UTF-16 and writes to the Windows console.

methods.name: set_console_attr
methods.description: Sets console text attributes based on current style flags.

methods.name: erase_in_line
methods.description: Clears the current line in the console buffer.

methods.name: set_attr
methods.description: Parses ANSI escape codes and updates console attributes accordingly.

methods.name: console_thread
methods.description: Thread function that reads from a pipe and processes ANSI escape sequences for console output.

methods.name: winansi_exit
methods.description: Cleans up console thread and handles on program exit.

methods.name: die_lasterr
methods.description: Handles Windows errors and terminates the program with an error message.

methods.name: winansi_dup2
methods.description: Duplicates a file descriptor, updating internal console handle state if necessary.

methods.name: duplicate_handle
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of a Windows handle.

methods.name: swap_osfhnd
methods.description: Replaces the OS handle associated with a file descriptor.

methods.name: detect_msys_tty
methods.description: Detects if a file descriptor is connected to an MSYS2 or Cygwin pseudo-terminal.

methods.name: winansi_isatty
methods.description: Wrapper around isatty() that uses cached state for standard input/output/error.

methods.name: winansi_init
methods.description: Initializes console handling, sets up pipes and threads for console output.

methods.name: winansi_get_osfhandle
methods.description: Returns the real Windows handle for stdout/stderr if redirected through pipes.
